key_idea: For a fixed graph Γ and large c, proper c-colorings of the exponential graph E_c(Γ) are forced by a counting argument to be 'robust' near a single vertex. This rigidity is then contradicted by an explicit clique and a two-valued mapping built on G⊠K_q, where G has large girth and fractional chromatic number.
reason: In a page and a half the proof settles a 50-year-old conjecture with elementary means: Observation 1, a short pigeonhole count, and two explicit constructions. Some ad hoc choices (the constant 3.1, the girth-6 distance layers, the n-th-root bound) make it a bit less inevitable than a true book proof.
recognized: Tardif's [year] simplification/variant of Shitov's counterexample to Hedetniemi's conjecture — specifically Shitov's 'Counterexamples to Hedetniemi's conjecture' (Annals of Math. 2019)
